population.proposal: 2,000 synthetic customers, each owning one wallet; 160 agents.
population.rationale: 50 transactions per wallet on average supports behavioural history while 160 agents average 469 agent-mediated events and allow disjoint evaluation groups.

customers.wallet_ownership: one customer to one wallet in this dataset version
customers.wallet_transaction_distribution: bounded over-dispersed discrete distribution, 35–75 per wallet, constrained to exactly 100,000 total
customers.minimum_history: Scenario-eligible wallets require 12 earlier events; all wallets receive at least 20 baseline normal events where allocation permits.

agents.minimum_history: Agent scenarios require 30 earlier attributable events; otherwise Stage 10B neutral cold start applies.

catalogue: varied directions, amounts and time patterns
normal_behaviour.hard_negative_rule: Include benign cases sharing individual high-volume, near-threshold, burst, repeat-counterparty and repeat-agent characteristics with suspicious cases.

suspicious_behaviour.rule: Each event has one primary scenario family for allocation but may participate in a varied, group-local behavioural sequence.

structuring_scenarios.amount: bounded log-normal around wallet baseline; not fixed to threshold
structuring_scenarios.diversity: varied channel, direction, baseline and duration

structuring_scenarios.signal: repeated amount ratio and low dispersion
structuring_scenarios.diversity: amount scale overlaps normal repeated payments

structuring_scenarios.amount: mixture of low, medium and high baseline-relative draws
structuring_scenarios.diversity: some sequences include new, some established counterparties

structuring_scenarios.amount: mixture: 40–80% near synthetic threshold, remainder not near it
structuring_scenarios.signal: historical near-threshold ratio combined with fragmentation
structuring_scenarios.diversity: normal cases also contain near-threshold events

network_scenarios.diversity: vary hub, amounts, timing and edge density
varied recipient persistence and value allocation
vary cycle length, values and relationship history
gradual and abrupt shifts with different prior relationship depths
vary cluster density and external counterparties

agent_scenarios.signal: agent count/value growth and new wallets

agent_scenarios.diversity: vary burst size, time and value
baseline-relative values overlap legitimate high value
vary direction mix and transaction type
vary shared counterparties, wallet count and network density

scenario_parameter_ranges.amounts: Wallet-baseline-scaled bounded log-normal mixtures; use categorical low/medium/high legitimate profiles and overlap normal/suspicious supports.
scenario_parameter_ranges.spacing: Log-uniform/bounded random for burst intervals; empirical-style time-of-day and day-of-week distributions with scenario-time overlap.
scenario_parameter_ranges.counts: Bounded discrete ranges specified per family.
scenario_parameter_ranges.network_structure: Partition-local stochastic relationship graphs with family parameters sampled per instance.
scenario_parameter_ranges.seed: Master seed plus recorded deterministic sub-seeds per partition, entity, scenario and sequence.

transaction_direction.rule: Every transaction has exactly one sender_wallet and one receiver_wallet. sender perspective is outgoing; receiver perspective is incoming. transaction_direction is derived per feature perspective, not a categorical identity.
transaction_direction.agent_attribution: agent_id identifies the servicing agent when the event is agent-mediated; NULL otherwise. Agent inbound/outbound sums follow sender/receiver direction of attributable events.
transaction_direction.reciprocity: A counterparty is reciprocal only when earlier edges exist in both directions between the same two wallets.

reporting_threshold_governance.metadata: record threshold value and version in generation_metadata, never X or y
reporting_threshold_governance.change_policy: new value requires a new configuration version and regenerated experiment; it cannot be inferred from labels
reporting_threshold_governance.anti_shortcut: Near-threshold activity is neither necessary nor sufficient for suspiciousness; include normal near-threshold and suspicious non-near-threshold scenarios.

independent_population.independence: new entities, new scenario instances, new parameter combinations, distinct temporal placement, distinct graph realizations and no copied sequences; a new seed alone is insufficient.

isolation_rules.wallet_customer: Immutable partition assignment before generation; one customer/wallet belongs to exactly one partition.
isolation_rules.agents: Each agent belongs to exactly one partition; no agent history or relationship crosses partitions.
isolation_rules.edges: All counterparties and scenario participants are partition-local; no cross-partition edges.
isolation_rules.history: Feature history is calculated only from earlier ordered records within the same partition.

temporal_rules.event_sequence: unique deterministic global integer allocated after planned event ordering, retained as metadata only

ground_truth_rules.assignment: Scenario engine assigns binary label and metadata before feature extraction.

feature_matrix_contract.X: exact Stage 10B allow-list of 30 features; fail closed on extra, missing or duplicate columns

cold_start.rule: Stage 10B neutral/no-evidence policy: counts/sums/ratios/shares/entropy/concentration/dispersion/z-scores=0; new flags=0 until required history; NULL agent=all agent features 0.

anti_template_acceptance: no transaction type or 3-hour bin differs by more than 0.20 absolute prevalence between labels without documented review
amount distribution overlap checked by quantile overlap and single-feature AUC review

research_justification: This is a controlled synthetic environment for evaluating temporal structuring, wallet-network and agent-behaviour AML decision support with unseen-entity evaluation. It is not evidence of actual EcoCash customer behaviour or proof that a model detects real money laundering.
unresolved_items: Approval of proposed population and partition numbers
approval of scenario allocation and parameter ranges
approval of synthetic threshold v1 value
approval of agent attribution coverage and partition-local graph policy

readiness_status.reason: Concrete proposals are complete, but each numerical and governance decision requiring researcher approval remains unapproved.
